project_type: Next.js 14 App Router dashboard for copy trading management
test_framework: vitest with jsdom, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build to verify no TypeScript or build errors. Run pnpm test to verify tests pass.
setup_instructions: pnpm install, prisma generate (handled by postinstall)
environment_constraints: No database available for runtime queries. Demo mode uses mock data. Build validation is the primary verification.
contribution_requirements: Use existing patterns: shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS, Recharts for charts, Lucide icons
key_patterns: Components in src/components/{feature}/. Pages use App Router at src/app/{route}/page.tsx with layout.tsx wrapping in AppShell. API routes at src/app/api/. UI components at src/components/ui/. Mock data fallback pattern when API unavailable. KpiCard for metrics display. Recharts for charts (AreaChart, BarChart). DateRangePicker for filtering.
directory_structure: src/app/ - App Router pages and layouts. src/components/ - UI components organized by feature (accounts, dashboard, groups, metrics, shared, ui). src/lib/ - utilities, auth, prisma, trading logic, metrics calculations. prisma/ - schema and seed.
